description: Tune BB's type, icons, prompt box, menus and shortcuts with switches that BB itself does not offer. Clearer hierarchy, on by default, makes thread titles bolder and chat text slightly larger. Switch interface icons between BB Default, Lucide, Iconoir and Tabler Outline, and give the spinner its own style. Move the new-thread prompt to the top, center or bottom, hide Steer labels, turn on richer File Editor highlighting, and hide apps from the Open With menu. Alt+1 to Alt+9 switch right-panel tabs, and settings are saved on the BB server so every device shares them. Needs BB 0.49 or newer; no account or external service.
